description:
McPeake Auctioneers are delighted to present 3 Bealing Avenue a four-bedroom detached family home which extends to approximately 132 sq.m. over three spacious storeys and offers generously proportioned accommodation throughout.

Presented in good condition, the property boasts bright and well-balanced living space, making it an ideal home for families. The accommodation includes a large formal living room with French doors opening onto a south-east facing rear garden, allowing for excellent natural light throughout the day. The kitchen/dining area is bright and practical, while a separate utility room provides additional convenience and storage.
A standout feature of this home is its generous bedroom accommodation. There are four double bedrooms, including two bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, together with a well-appointed family bathroom.

Outside, the south-east facing rear garden is designed for low maintenance with artificial grass and enjoys access to two designated parking spaces. The parking spaces are currently secured with bollards, providing added security and exclusivity.

Detached four-bedroom homes of this size and layout rarely come to the market in Tyrrelstown. Combining spacious accommodation, four bathrooms, a utility room and a desirable south-east facing garden, this is an excellent opportunity to acquire a family home in Tyrrelstown.

 Tyrrelstown which is approx. 8 miles from Central Dublin, south of the old Hollystown golf course, set between the Navan and the Ashbourne Road, and within 2 miles of the Blanchardstown Centre. The development is close to all amenities the Blanchardstown centre has to offer, and has the added benefit of being located within walking distance of The Tyrrelstown Town Centre which include retailers such as Supervalu, Lidl, Paddy Power, Hickeys Pharmacy and a variety of other shops and facilities.
